description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, specifically for USD, with dynamic precision and optional inclusion of credits based on a fixed conversion rate. It ensures consistent display of currency values across the application.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with optional credits suffix, handling dynamic decimal precision based on the value's magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amounts with credits appended, utilizing the main formatting function.
